proof_body:
by
  intro a d k hd h hk hak hak1 n hn
  have nonneg : ∀ j i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i + j = k → 0 ≤ a i := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro i _ hi
      have e : i = k := by omega
      rw [e]
      exact hak
    | succ j ih =>
      intro i hi hij
      have h1 := ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [h i hi] at h1
      linarith
  have nonpos : ∀ m : ℕ, k ≤ m → a (m + 1) ≤ 0 := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hak1
    | succ m hm ih =>
      rw [h (m + 1) (by omega)]
      linarith
  rcases le_total n k with hnk | hkn
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · exact Finset.Icc_subset_Icc_right hnk
    · intro i hi _
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
      exact nonneg (k - i) i hi.1 (by omega)
  · clear hn
    induction n, hkn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact le_rfl
    | succ m hm ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      have h1 := nonpos m hm
      linarith
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (k : ℕ), d < 0 → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = a n + d) → 1 ≤ k → 0 ≤ a k → a (k + 1) ≤ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, a i
